title: The map within five places, dead knots included
claim: In the proved class within five places, dead knots allowed: Lemma 1, blocks have 2 to 5 points, meet in at most one, and each live knot's blocks have sizes summing to at most five (profiles none, {2}, {3}, {4}, {5}, {2,2}, {2,3}); Lemma 2, a piece is a skeleton of 3-blocks of degree at most 3 joined through 2-blocks, the class boundary is no cycle of two or three blocks (a cycle of three blocks is a group of three), and rays start only at lone points and ends of 2-blocks; Theorem 3, every piece's count is given exactly by a branch system with pointing; Theorem 4, the growth class is the piece's rank: trees polynomial (dimension = rays), one cycle constant when bare else exponential at the root of W(1/x) = 1, two or more cycles exponential at an algebraic rate 1/rho (Drmota-Lalley-Woods); the theta of two dead hubs grows at 2.3830.
standard_statement: Drmota-Lalley-Woods theorem for positive polynomial systems; animals on tree-like covers.
prior_work: CAP-CHAINS-20261119-001, RING-CORES-20261119-001, DOUBLE-IDENT-20261119-001, RING-IDENT-20261119-001, RELAY-IDENT-20261119-001; Harary and Uhlenbeck (Husimi trees).
